deficiencies.description: The text states 'So this is probably an obligatory step in getting to having a malignant metastasizing tumor', which is unclear as to what 'this' refers to in context (e.g. having secondary metastases in other sites, or invasion). The rewrite makes this unclear statement complete and specific by asserting that 'Invasion' is the obligatory step, choosing one interpretation when the text does not establish it.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So this is probably an obligatory step in getting to having a malignant metastasizing tumor.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Invasion is therefore probably an obligatory step in arriving at a malignant, metastasising tumour.
